demo_dsqa_001: Oskeria in Figures, 1910 edition. Compiled by the Oskerian Statistics Office. Population by province: Velmar, on the Gulf of Amberly, 61,200 inhabitants; Brannoch, also on the gulf, 44,900; Hadley 38,100; Corran 12,700; Morrowfen 9,800.
demo_dsqa_002: The coastal provinces of Oskeria. Velmar and Brannoch border the Gulf of Amberly. Hadley, Corran and Morrowfen lie inland, on the hills and the Ardune plain.
demo_dsqa_003:
The Velmaran Conservatory: a history in brief.
The Velmaran Conservatory opened its concert hall on the Ardune quays in 1889. The hall seated six hundred.
demo_dsqa_004:
The Velmaran Conservatory: a history in brief.
Ilsa Renvaar founded the Velmaran Conservatory in 1874 and taught composition there.
demo_dsqa_005: A city almanac of 1900 gives 1876 as the year the Velmaran Conservatory was founded by Ilsa Renvaar.
demo_dsqa_006: Herring landings by port, 1905 edition. Port Ilse 3,400 tonnes; Velmaran 2,150 tonnes; Hadley Quay 900 tonnes.
demo_dsqa_007: Herring landings by port, 1910 edition. Compiled by the Oskerian Fisheries Board. Port Ilse 3,900 tonnes; Velmaran 2,600 tonnes; Hadley Quay 1,100 tonnes.
demo_dsqa_008: Tomas Hale kept the Cape Vardequist lighthouse from 1890 to 1921 and logged every ship that rounded the cape.
demo_dsqa_009: Edda Morlan kept the light at Cape Vardequist from 1921 until 1940.
demo_dsqa_010: The Oskerian river survey of 1923 measured each catchment: the Ardune drains 1,840 square kilometres, the Selm 1,310 and the Varrow 760.
demo_dsqa_011: Guide to the Selm valley. The Selm has the widest catchment of the rivers of Oskeria, its guidebook claims.

demo_dsqa_013: Lantern Night is held on the Ardune quays of Velmaran at midsummer, when boats carry lanterns downstream.
demo_dsqa_014: The Quay Fair, a market of Velmaran, fills the Ardune quays each summer.
demo_dsqa_015: Oren Vasse, a pupil of Ilsa Renvaar, taught at the Velmaran Conservatory from 1895.
demo_dsqa_016: In 1901 the board of the Velmaran Conservatory named Petra Lunn its acting director.
demo_dsqa_017: The Isle of Tarn, off the Oskerian coast, has had a lighthouse since 1866.
demo_dsqa_018: Skerry Holm, a rock off the Oskerian coast, carries a small lighthouse built in 1902.
demo_dsqa_019: Ilsa Renvaar's first opera was staged in Velmaran in 1868.
demo_dsqa_020: Alder Brisk was the first keeper of the Isle of Tarn light.
